summary: Matternet, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its common stock qualified to trade on the OTCQB Venture Market and commenced trading September 21, 2026 under ticker MTTN. No securities are registered under Section 12(b), and the filing contains no transaction terms, counterparties, board recommendation, or advisors. This is an ordinary listing-transfer/qualification announcement, not a special situation. No stake, price, premium, or close date is stated. What to watch: OTCQB quotation liquidity, disclosure cadence, and any subsequent financing or uplisting, none of which is event risk today.
